name: first-reveal-probe
description: Investigative, not a regression gate. Finding: this harness cannot sample the frost mid-fade on a first reveal. The capture is chained directly off the move that triggers the reveal, no wait_vlog and no settle first, yet every frame from t=160ms to t=751ms already reads the fully-shown region_mean (196.8,199.0,203.2) - the same value a sibling scenario's settled panel-over-page reads. Unlike the dismiss path, a reveal has no debounce ahead of its 240ms animation, so there is no window past dispatch latency left to land a frame inside. This is why the-frost-hides-with-the-panel.json carries no first-reveal opacity gate: the fix (constructing the frost at opacity 0) rests on code review, not on a measurement this harness can make.
